definitions: To build, pave, or wall with bricks.
To block or seal (an opening) with bricks.
To make something solid or unyielding like a brick.
To cause an electronic device to become completely inoperable, often due to a software or firmware malfunction.
examples: They decided to brick up the old fireplace.
The builders will brick the new extension.
A bad update can brick your phone.
He bricked the window to prevent entry.
